name: Stygian-Astrolabe
description: Cloud-architecture stacks to the horizon in every direction, ammonia cirrus above, sulfurous murk below. Great storm eyes stare up out of the depths, unhurried and permanent.
Every altitude has its own weather opinion, and the hull is the only referee. Mooring in the quiet shear zones is a skill measured in survived seasons.
Surveyors date the monolithic structures of unknown origin to before the region's last cataclysm, which should be impossible. The structures are unweathered, as if time skipped this place.
For traders, helium-3 alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
